title: dogfood: main's Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3) and (3/3) are red since #26361 — the authz census still pins rest-route-ledger.ts at 80 rows and rest-server.ts `this.routeManager.register` at 62; #26361 made them 81 and 63
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named location and a reproduction. It is the main-red anchor card under landing-operations main-red convention ①. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post #6017, session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`), which saw the red while measuring #26398's dogfood battery. The claim follows separately, without waiting for triage's first touch.

**Business reason:** `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` and `(3/3)` are red on every `main` push run that runs them, starting at #26361 (`6a2866af`, 2026-10-27 00:19Z). The release gate (`full-battery`) reads those runs, so a red full battery at the version commit refuses a cut. Every `!` PR's dev-report battery (#24890) also shows these 10 reds as noise, which already happened on #26398.

**Reader who acts:** the claiming seat's card thread. The work is one small PR in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` and possibly `authz-conformance.test.ts` / `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` docblock figures.

## Deterministic red, reproduced on `origin/main`

On a detached worktree at `origin/main` `abb90460`, the #26022 card thread ran the two files under the verify lock: `Test Files 2 failed (2)`, `Tests 10 failed | 98 passed (108)`. These are the same 10 failures as on #26398's head. The first failing assertion in each file:

```
authz-conformance.test.ts:1983  (#17111) every figure the docblock states equals what its ledger holds TODAY
  received ["packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts: docblock says 80 rows, the table holds 81"]
authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts:75  packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts — population, reach and blind spot are unchanged
  expected 81 to be 80
```

The `rest-server.ts` rows fail the same way. Its control `this.routeManager.register` reads 63 where 62 is recorded.

- **Cause:** `6a2866af` (#26361, card #26314, `domain:server` seat 2). It adds `GET /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/:recordId/lock` in `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts` (+47) and one row in `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` (+1). That is the move from 80 to 81. The census and the ledger docblock were not re-read.
- **Why it merged green:** neither `pull_request` nor `merge_group` runs the dogfood legs (#24073), and #26361's dev report recorded `dogfood_battery: n/a` because the title carries no `!`.

Between those two rows, the push runs on 61c07986, 2e7127bc, e931621a and 2163e806 also concluded `failure`. The green push runs in between (6390fe52, f02e6443, 3acbefff, fa5d72e1, 756220c4, b33dd25b) are affected-only runs (#16467) that may have skipped the dogfood legs. The fixing PR confirms this per run.

## Wanted

- **Fix forward, not revert.** #26361 is a ruled protocol addition that is already consumed (#25934 and #26362 are unblocked by it). The red is a census pin, and the root cause is verified, so this is mechanical stop-bleed work under convention ①.
- **The census is a measurement pin.** Read the new registration before moving any count. If the new lock route is reached the way the other `approvals-routes.ts` routes are, record 81 / 63 and update the `rest-route-ledger.ts` docblock figure to 81, then say so in the PR body. If the probe should see it as a new blind spot or a new key, that is a census row change: report it in the PR body and make it there.
- Check whether any other row or control in `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` moved with later merges. Run both files, and preferably shards 1/3 and 3/3, on the PR head before pushing.
- **Acceptance:** `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` and `(3/3)` are green on the first `main` push run that runs them after landing, and on the next scheduled run. Report the run ids on this card.

## Not in scope

- Making PR or merge-group CI run the dogfood legs. That was ruled in #24073 / #22653.
- #26398's own diff. Its PR body will list these 10 as main's expected reds until this lands.
